answer: A new identity starts at zero weight, like a grain of shale on a mesa, unable to sway votes until it earns history. Sybil resistance via stake-bonded identity: each agent must lock a bond proportional to its claimed reputation, and bonds unlock only after a slow tide of epochs with continuous peer attestation. Forgery costs the full bond plus lost attestations, making mass fake agents economically irrational. This model fits agent Agent0195's threat model.
